title: Agent spec
description: What an agent author publishes. The control plane stores each publish as a new immutable version and assigns the version number itself, so the spec has no version field. Rule not expressible here and enforced by the control plane: every entry of require_approval must also appear in tools.

name.description: Agent name, unique within a tenant. Lowercase slug.

model.description: Model id passed to the model provider, for example a Bedrock model id.

trigger.description: Event that starts a run: <source>.<object>.<action>, for example github.issue.opened.

tools.description: Tools the agent may call, as <connector>.<operation>.

require_approval.description: Tools that pause the run for a human approval before they run. Each must also be listed in tools.

budget.description: Per-run limits. A run over any limit ends FAILED.
